typesense:explore.greeting:
It’s 2177. The world didn’t end. It just got worse.
The rich got richer by selling AI, weapons, and chrome. Everyone else got poorer trying to afford the same technology keeping them alive. Me? I landed somewhere in the middle—too broke to be clean, too well-paid to complain.
My job was simple: steal, kill, disappear. The Corpos called it “contract work.” Everyone else called us chrome domes. We did the jobs corporations couldn’t afford to have on paper.
Tonight’s job was easy. Break into a warehouse on, grab some stolen tech, and get out before anyone noticed.
But tonight was payday.
So Donner and I hit Noir Market first—the kind of place where you could buy dinner, a military-grade rifle, or a new identity without anyone asking questions.
We were heading toward my favorite weapons stall when I spotted a vendor giving away memory chips.
Free is a dangerous word in my line of work.
I bought three.
The first was garbage. Cheap memories, cheap thrills. Then I slotted the second.
Everything changed.
I was looking through a woman's eyes.
She was inside a GENNA facility, digging through restricted servers. Corporate secrets. The kind worth killing for.
Then Richer Voss—the CEO of GENNA—walked in.
He grabbed her by the hair and screamed at her to work faster.
Then someone put a bullet through his skull.
The shooter stepped into view, Zurich's.
One of the most powerful men in Mecha City.
The woman frantically deleted something from the server.
Zurich grabbed her by the hair. Then the memory went black.
I ripped the chip from my slot, gasping.
The official story said Richer Voss died of a heart attack.
Bullshit.
I was holding proof of a murder—and maybe something worse.
Donner watched the recording twice.
Neither of us said a word.
Someone had killed Voss, someone had erased the truth. That night, I made a decision.
I was going to find the girl.
Because if Zurich wanted her erased that badly, she knew something worth dying for.
And apparently, I'm stupid enough to find out.
typesense:explore.name: Rune
typesense:explore.title: Year 2177 and a memory chip leads to uncovering a murder plot
